statement: Relationship propagates first. Motion is a resolved description of that propagation.
Inheritance closes identity; propagation updates relational occupancy.
One object in the admitted unbounded environment does not earn an absolute propagation vector.
A second distinguishable object creates a pairwise relational domain without requiring absolute coordinates.
Common-mode ambient/field occupancy update may preserve pair relation and yield zero relative propagation.
Propagation morphism is prior to vector representation.
Lift, propagation/transport, and projection/readout remain distinct in corridor factorization.
Rainbow Road is used as the information-transport/dependency-route fabric for propagation.
